latestEvent.what_happened: 67-min exploratory call (https://fathom.video/share/NAsZ116uhHFcUFPDUk8Y5JEsoxbCzHHT). P-75D7 presented his world: an "Ancient Future" philosophy (AI + ancient wisdom — sound tech, plant medicines, traditions); ayahuasca ceremonies (his favorite medicine); he and his girlfriend as "wounded healers" who programmed Icaros/sound; a gamified, RPG-like ascension platform (profiles, levels, "chakras of earth", badges, an AI-guide, a marketplace of healers/experiences) launching officially in ~2 weeks, built to let "young souls" grow safely without falling into sects / predatory ayahuasqueros; a "spiritual crime" (духовное преступление) book on keeping the sacred sacred; "matrix-penetration" spiritual work (e.g. sound-healing for Las Vegas casino owners). Mission: recreate peace/harmony on the planet, open human potential, build a love-based world; anti-competition, pro-alliance ("we need a billion leaders for the 8 billion"). Grew up in Kharkiv, US at 19, ~7 years in San Diego. Sasha gave a clean full walk-through of his own thesis (uniqueness/signal → crystallizes into business → the AI-era sovereign-entrepreneur economy → he works with those who work with entrepreneurs) and — notably — stated his sovereignty stance aloud: he has been inside many such collective/ecosystem groups and concluded the real leverage is his own inner growth and where his uniqueness leads, surrender over building the big shared infrastructure. Collaboration was explored only loosely: P-75D7 offered mutual amplification ("we can send people to your program"), proposed reconnecting in 1-2 weeks to find concrete actions, and offered to intro his friends P-20B7 (Kyiv, meditation/breathwork) and Kateryna. Sasha raised a Russia-Ukraine bridge-building idea (two angles: surface people who transcend the conflict and model the meta-position; Russians + Ukrainians discussing from a high-vibration meta-position of collective trauma/geopolitics as a pattern-break for viewers) — P-75D7 was genuinely interested but cautious (deep wounds, not everyone ready); they agreed a separate dedicated meeting on it. Action items (Fathom): email P-20B7 & Kateryna re intro/collab; schedule a follow-up in 1-2 weeks.
